title: Product color within the O2 gradient
slide_intent: Relate a background accent to a product so the product feels integrated while the brand remains identifiable.
strategic_value: A stable blue upper field can retain O2 recognition while changing lower accents support different devices.
demonstration: A yellow phone, green-accented earbuds and watches appear in turn over blue gradients whose lower colors shift toward the products’ colors.
practical_value: Compare which part of a background can vary with the product while maintaining a consistent blue reference.

content_islands.name: Blue anchor
content_islands.spec: Keep the upper part of the frame blue through the sequence.

content_islands.name: Product and lower accent
content_islands.spec: Center each product above a lower gradient that changes toward yellow, green or pink with the device.

ingredient.name: Product-related gradient accent
ingredient.role: Connect the device color to its setting while retaining a blue brand reference.
ingredient.application: In the shown sequence, vary the lower gradient accent with the product and retain blue above.
ingredient.scope: Observed product presentation in the 2023 case study; no exact color values or mandatory proportions are supplied.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source section explicitly presents color as a way to add flexibility to the brand.
reference_purposes.Expression: Blue gradients acquire different lower accents while remaining visually related.
reference_purposes.Application: The sequence pairs those color variations with individual consumer devices.
